title: Item descriptions don't consistently signal 'this thread is closed' — the tin reliquary and the woven eel-trap charm correctly gain 'nothing is owed on it' text once resolved, but the rod shaft/ferrule and the shield-bosses satchel never do, so a player re-checking inventory after finishing those quests is told (falsely) that something is still missing.
